_comment: Governed variant of mcp_config.json. The reconnaissance agent is pointed at the governed MCP server (src/tools/mcp/governed_recon.py), which routes every tool call through the KKI IRP governance layer (validation -> policy -> network scope -> attestation -> consent -> audit) before anything executes. Run governed_recon.py on port 3001 in place of Reconnaissance.py; the URL below is unchanged so this is a drop-in swap. Set KKI_PATH, KKI_NETWORK_SCOPE, and KKI_CONSENT_MODE in the environment before launching.
